name: Grok Telegram
tagline: Puts your bot behind Telegram DMs on a webhook that never calls the model
description: A single walkthrough that ends with your bot answering Telegram messages. It starts at minting a BotFather token, bridges incoming DMs through a webhook that makes no model call on the way in, and can expose the whole thing through a tunnel so an idle setup costs you almost nothing to run.
author: siraustin
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
